correctness.rationale: The quotient has N even-weight characters and no other Fourier modes. Cesàro averaging retains the projector Schur squares, so the weight-w multiplier counts ordered equal-even-weight pairs with fixed sum divided by N. Balancing the w changed coordinates selects w/2; on a nonempty complement exactly half the subsets have the requisite parity. At full support the sole complement is empty and d/2 must itself be even. The only zero is therefore the full-support parity character when d ≡ 2 mod 4. Interior central-binomial ratios decrease, and in the nonzero endpoint case its ratio to the last interior mode is 2(d−1)/d>1. These facts give the multiplicities, gap and condition number including d=3 and d=4. The bundled numerical-range checks were inspected only; the proof is exact for all d.

evidence: The Hamming proof counts all equal-weight characters, with q unrestricted local choices on a coordinate outside the support. The folded proof requires even total weight, which halves the allowed complement choices only if the complement is nonempty.
claim_vs_prior_implication.reasoning: One must carry the amplitudes or the even-weight projectors through the quotient before averaging. Equivalently, the normalized quotient amplitude is U(x)+U(x+1); across antipodes the extra cross term is proportional to cos(dπ/2)(sin t cos t)^d (−1)^|x| and so changes only the even-dimensional parity mode. It is not present in the ordinary squared-probability spectrum. The rank transition and its endpoint comparison are a distinct computation, not a parameter substitution.

originality.rationale: The ordinary cube covers the numerical interior formula, not the quotient mixing theorem. The distinct contribution is the quotient correction and the resulting unified spectrum, rank transition and sharp positive minimum. The comparison does not rely on ordering two records with the same date.
residual_risks: Fan–Luo's 2013 cubelike paper was not independently retrieved; accessible related passages address instantaneous mixing.
Explicit results for arbitrary linear quotients or association-scheme Krein sums may give equivalent coverage; the bounded searches do not establish its absence.

value.rationale: The quotient introduces a real interference effect invisible in ordinary-cube probabilities: one parity eigenmode alternates between a positive endpoint and exact nullity. The all-dimension calculation also gives the sharp conditioning on the image and verifies full rank for the odd folded-cube subfamily in a broader problem about distance-regular graphs.
